newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemen seeks $100 mln World Bank loan.
newsitem.headline: Yemen seeks $100 mln World Bank loan.

text.p: Yemen on Thursday said it was negotiating a $100 million loan with the World Bank to support administrative reforms it plans to implement.
"The minister of Civil Service and Administrative Reform is in Washington for talks on this issue with the World Bank," a ministry official told Reuters.
He said the soft loan was not part of a three-year $1.8 billion soft loan package promised by donor nations in Brussels in June.
Yemen, one of the Arab world's poorest states, is implementing a stringent three-phase economic reform programme prescribed by the World Bank and the International Monetary Fund.
Lifting subsidies and cutting back on public sector employment are among steps Yemen plans to undertake to reduce spending.
Official figures estimate the public sector workforce in Yemen at about 450,000 to 500,000.
The official said Yemen had stopped employment of new graduates in its civil service, but some exceptions were being made in the health and education departments.
